# DataMatrix

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders text or binary data as a vector Data Matrix ECC200 symbol.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IAltTextProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new DataMatrix(options?: DataMatrixOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`altText`](#alttext): Alternate text description for accessibility.
- [`backgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Quiet-zone colour.
- [`data`](#data): The data/text to encode.
- [`drawBackground`](#drawbackground): Whether to draw the background.
- [`foregroundColor`](#foregroundcolor): Module colour.
- [`gs1`](#gs1): Encode the GS1 start and field separators.
- [`isDecorative`](#isdecorative): When `true`, the symbol is tagged as a decorative `/Artifact`.
- [`quietZone`](#quietzone): Number of quiet-zone modules around the symbol.
- [`rectangular`](#rectangular): Request a rectangular symbol for short messages where one is available.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
- [`size`](#size): The display width of the symbol in points (the quiet zone is included).

### `altText`

```typescript
altText: string
```

Alternate text description for accessibility. Populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element when the document opts into PDF/UA-1.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
dm.altText = `Data Matrix encoding ${data}`;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
dm.altText = `Rectangular Data Matrix encoding ${data}`;
```

### `backgroundColor`

```typescript
backgroundColor: Color
```

Quiet-zone colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
if (bg) dm.backgroundColor = bg;
```

### `data`

```typescript
data: string
```

The data/text to encode. Any Unicode string is accepted.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
dm.data = data;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
basicDm.data = 'https://www.bonniepdf.dev';
```

### `drawBackground`

```typescript
drawBackground: boolean
```

Whether to draw the background. If `false`, the symbol is transparent.

### `foregroundColor`

```typescript
foregroundColor: Color
```

Module colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
dm.foregroundColor = fg;
```

### `gs1`

```typescript
gs1: boolean
```

Encode the GS1 start and field separators.

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative: boolean
```

When `true`, the symbol is tagged as a decorative `/Artifact`.

### `quietZone`

```typescript
quietZone: number
```

Number of quiet-zone modules around the symbol. The spec requires at least 1. Default 2.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
dm.quietZone = 2;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
basicDm.quietZone = 2;
```

### `rectangular`

```typescript
rectangular: boolean
```

Request a rectangular symbol for short messages where one is available. Defaults to `false` (square symbols).

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
dm.rectangular = true;
```

### `semanticRole`

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. [`SemanticRole.H1`](semantic-role.md#h1), [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p), [`SemanticRole.Figure`](semantic-role.md#figure)).

### `size`

```typescript
size: number
```

The display width of the symbol in points (the quiet zone is included). For square symbols the height equals the width; for rectangular symbols the height is derived from the symbol's aspect ratio.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'3cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
dm.size = 95;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/data-matrix`:

```typescript
dm.size = 140;
```
